# pub

<!-- The reference table below this banner is regenerated by `make generate`. Handwritten prose below the table lives in internal/support/prose/. -->

This page explains how Bomly builds a dependency graph for `pub` projects: the detector chain it runs, what that chain needs, and what it can report.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package manager | `pub` |
| Ecosystem | `dart` |
| Detector chain | `pub-native-detector`, `pub-detector`, `syft-detector` |
| Evidence patterns | `pubspec.lock`, `pubspec.yaml`, `pubspec.yml` |
| Multi-module resolution | No |
| Install-first support | No |
| Remediation hints | None |
| Commands the chain may run | `dart`. The Syft fallback is built in; the lite build runs an external `syft` from `PATH` instead. |

## Source details

Bomly reads hosted, Git, and path sources from `pubspec.lock` or from the output of the `dart` tool. An unrecognized source type stays unknown.
